newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Silicon Graphics jumps.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Silicon Graphics jumps.

text.p: Shares in Silicon Graphics Inc rose sharply before markets opened Friday, boosted by stronger than expected fourth quarter earnings, traders said.
"That's the big mover this morning," one said.
The shares were trading at 24-1/2, up from a Thursday close of 19-7/16. The stock had jumped as high as 23 in after-hours trading, following release of the company's results.
The maker of computer workstations reported fiscal fourth-quarter earnings of $0.56 a share against a loss of $0.30a year ago. The earnings were well above a First Call consensus estimate of $0.34.

Among other active shares, Gateway 2000 Inc was trading at 42-1/4, down from a closing price of 43-5/16, after The Wall Street Journal reported it was scrambling to win large-business customers for its personal computers.

Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp was trading at 36-5/16 from a close of 35-7/16. The New York Times reported its chairman and chief executive appeared close to resigning amid a federal probe into its billing practices.
CHS Electronics fell to 32-1/2 from 33, and Sun Microsystems Inc was at 46-1/2 from a close of 46-8/16.
Telefonos de Mexico rose to 52 from 51-13/16, and Digital Equipment Corp was unchanged at 42-9/16.
